title: Read stored Q&A at generation end, not start, so mid-run saves merge
context: Notes generation captured the stored summary and pending Q&A when it started. The model can run for a long time, so answers and translations saved meanwhile were overwritten when the merged result was saved. Auto-title and save ordering had similar races: an older summary PUT could land last, and a rename during generation could be overwritten by the auto-title.
decision: generateAndSave now accepts `existing` and `pending` as either values or getter functions, and reads them after summarize() finishes. RecordingDetail passes a `getStore` getter that returns the live summaryRef and pendingRef, which are kept in refs so they are current. Summary saves are chained through `saveSerial`, so PUTs run one after another. Auto-title re-checks the recording's current name (`autoRename`) before renaming. Leaving a recording aborts its notes generation.
consequences: Q&A and translations saved while the model runs are merged into the result, not lost.
Notes generation depends on a ref-backed store; `pendingRef` and `summaryRef` must stay in sync with state updates (`onGenerated` resets both).
Summary saves are serialized, which adds latency to rapid successive edits. A failed save does not block later ones, because the chain catches errors.
Leaving a recording now aborts its notes generation, so a generation in progress is discarded when the user navigates away.
generateAndSave keeps accepting plain values, so callers that do not pass getters keep the snapshot behavior.
alternatives_rejected: Snapshotting `summary` and `pending` when generation starts (the previous `existing: summary || null, pending` arguments), which the change replaces with getters.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Snapshotting `summary` and `pending` when generation starts (the previous `existing: summary || null, pending` arguments), which the change replaces with getters.
